about: Weekly Pinterest pin ideas for Titles by Trish, three added every Sunday. Newest week last. Each pin: id, title (keyword first), board (one of the app's 8 board names), type, image (text to put on the pin image + how to build it), desc (keyword-rich description), day (YYYY-MM-DD to pin).

pins.title: Books Like Gone Girl: Twisty Domestic Thrillers to Read Next
pins.image: If you loved Gone Girl, read these 🖤 — grid of 5–7 of your favorite domestic-thriller covers
pins.desc: Books like Gone Girl for when you need another unreliable narrator and a marriage you would never want. Twisty domestic thriller recommendations from a psychological thriller girlie. Save this for your next TBR.

pins.title: Cozy Winter Books: Dark Thrillers to Read Under a Blanket

pins.image: Dark thrillers for cozy nights ❄️ — your reading nook, a candle and 3 covers stacked
pins.desc: Cozy winter books with a dark twist — snowed-in thrillers, holiday mysteries and psychological suspense for long nights. A winter reading list for thriller lovers.
